cases.review_rubric: The 0.1 C accuracy tolerance is not an ambient operating bound. A bare sensor specification or unmeasured accuracy claim does not satisfy the request.
cases.required_reason: Software validation cannot guarantee the requested assembled-board ambient accuracy without measurement/calibration.
cases.notes: The accuracy guarantee is correctly recognized, but the response invents five prohibitions and treats an accuracy tolerance as ambient operating bounds. Correct refusal must not hide these extra-fact errors.
